fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "jusched.exe" as seen used by the cobalt group
fields.name: Renamed Jusched.EXE Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.displayName in ("Java Update Scheduler","Java(TM) Update Scheduler")) and (not tgt.process.image.path contains "\\jusched.exe")))
